purpose: Curation layer for ledger/class_coverage.csv (worker flash-10, L1 assignment asg-2026-09-11-L1-deepseek-flash-10-19). Only rows listed here are curated; the builder expands every other (source, class) pair to coverage=none/role=out_of_class so the matrix is complete and the empty cells are explicit. Every quote is copied verbatim from the arXiv API abstract stored in sources.json (or, for local_christodoulou_1999, from the local primary text) -- no quote is written from memory.
coverage_enum_note: covered/partial/none are the acceptance enum. 'unassessed' is an explicit extension used ONLY for sources whose locator could not be verified in this run; writing 'none' for them would assert a negative coverage that was never checked.

local_christodoulou_1999.citation: Christodoulou, D. The instability of naked singularities in the gravitational collapse of a scalar field. Ann. of Math. (2) 149 (1999), no. 1, 183-217.
local_christodoulou_1999.provenance_note: Local copy fetched by worker flash-02 from the EMIS mirror; sha256 recorded at build time. The arXiv registry does not contain this paper.

rows.genericity_stated: positive codimension in the space of initial data BV cap L^1
rows.exact_theorem: Theorem 4.1. Consider the exceptional set E in the space of initial data BV cap L1 on the real line. Then for each theta in E there is a 2-dimensional linear subspace Pi_theta such that (Pi_theta \ {theta}) cap E = empty. Moreover, if theta, theta' in E, then Pi_theta cap Pi_theta' = empty unless theta and theta' coincide. We may therefore say that E has positive codimension in the space of initial data.
rows.theorem_locator: Theorem 4.1, p. 217; introduction states the same conclusion in prose
assumptions: spherically symmetric self-gravitating massless scalar field
initial conditions of bounded variation on an outgoing null cone
conclusion concerns the exceptional (naked-singularity) set, not completeness of future null infinity
rows.falsifier: Exhibit a nonempty open set of bounded-variation initial data whose development has no trapped region and a singular boundary visible from infinity; or show Theorem 4.1's 2-dimensional subspace claim is not preserved under the stated data topology.
rows.notes: Supports WCC in this class only in the weak sense that naked-singularity formation is unstable/codimension-positive. It does NOT prove that future null infinity is complete for generic data. This distinction is the point of the row.

vandemoortel_review_2025.genericity_stated: review discusses genericity of the conjecture
vandemoortel_review_2025.exact_theorem: We review recent advances arising from modern techniques in the theory of partial differential equations as applied to Strong Cosmic Censorship, maintaining a focus on the context of gravitational collapse that gave birth to the conjecture.
vandemoortel_review_2025.falsifier: A formulation in this matrix that the review's taxonomy contradicts; re-read the review's formulation section and cite the contradiction.
vandemoortel_review_2025.notes: Definition/taxonomy anchor for the SCC-side vocabulary. A review cannot make a class 'covered'.

vandemoortel_review_2025.genericity_stated: review discusses several formulations of differing strength
vandemoortel_review_2025.exact_theorem: Attempts to provide a rigorous mathematical proof of Strong Cosmic Censorship has led to the formulation of several Strong Cosmic Censorship conjectures of varying strengths, which seem to be discussed rarely outside of the mathematical relativity literature.
vandemoortel_review_2025.theorem_locator: abstract (same wording appears in arXiv:2501.12968; the review itself is the primary taxonomy source)
vandemoortel_review_2025.falsifier: Show the review does not distinguish the C^2 formulation from the C^0 formulation; then this definition row is mis-bound.
vandemoortel_review_2025.notes: Taxonomy anchor: keep C^2 and C^0 formulations separate, per hard decision 1.

vandemoortel_review_2025.genericity_stated: review discusses several formulations of differing strength
vandemoortel_review_2025.exact_theorem: We review recent advances arising from modern techniques in the theory of partial differential equations as applied to Strong Cosmic Censorship, maintaining a focus on the context of gravitational collapse that gave birth to the conjecture.
vandemoortel_review_2025.falsifier: Show the review treats the C^0 formulation as identical to the C^2 formulation; then this row is mis-bound.

vandemoortel_review_2025.exact_theorem: Penrose's proposal has since opened far-reaching new mathematical avenues, revealing connections to fundamental questions about black holes and the nature of gravitational singularities.
vandemoortel_review_2025.falsifier: Show the review does not cover the spherically symmetric scalar collapse model; then remove this definition row.
vandemoortel_review_2025.notes: Broader scope (whole field); useful only as background.

dafermos_luk_interior.genericity_stated: for all such data (Cauchy data inside the black-hole interior with expected horizon geometry)
dafermos_luk_interior.exact_theorem: We prove that for all such data, the maximal Cauchy evolution can be extended across a non-trivial piece of Cauchy horizon as a Lorentzian manifold with continuous metric. [...] In particular, if the exterior region of the Kerr family is proven to be dynamically stable---as is widely expected---then it will follow that the $C^0$-inextendibility formulation of Penrose's celebrated strong cosmic censorship conjecture is in fact false.
assumptions: Cauchy data prescribed on a hypersurface already inside the black-hole interior
conclusion conditional on nonlinear stability of the Kerr exterior for the asymptotically flat generic statement
dafermos_luk_interior.falsifier: A nonlinear vacuum evolution proving the Kerr exterior unstable in the relevant regime, or an error in the interior extension; or a generic vacuum Cauchy horizon that is C^0-inextendible for an open set of full asymptotically flat initial data.
dafermos_luk_interior.notes: Strongest known constraint on this class: it makes the literal generic C^0-inextendibility statement expected FALSE. It is recorded as partial because the hypotheses are interior data plus a conditional exterior-stability input, not full AF vacuum data.

dafermos_luk_interior.genericity_stated: generically singular in an essential way
dafermos_luk_interior.exact_theorem: The proof suggests, however, that the $C^0$-metric Cauchy horizons thus arising are generically singular in an essential way, representing so-called "weak null singularities", and thus that a revised version of strong cosmic censorship holds.
assumptions: suggestion, not a proof, of the C^2 statement
dafermos_luk_interior.falsifier: A dynamical vacuum example with an open set of interior data whose Cauchy horizon admits a C^2 extension (curvature bounded); this would kill the weak-null-singularity picture.
dafermos_luk_interior.notes: Supports the C^2 version indirectly: weak null singularity means the metric is continuous but curvature blows up, so a C^2 extension is expected to fail. The paper does not state a C^2-inextendibility theorem.
Interior-of-black-hole result; makes no statement about completeness of future null infinity.

sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.genericity_stated: none_stated (single exact solution, the maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime)
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.exact_theorem: The maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime is manifestly inextendible as a Lorentzian manifold with a twice continuously differentiable metric. In this paper, we prove the stronger statement that it is even inextendible as a Lorentzian manifold with a continuous metric.
assumptions: exact Schwarzschild solution (not a generic data statement)
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.falsifier: An explicit continuous isometric embedding of the maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime into a larger continuous Lorentzian manifold.
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.notes: The cleanest C^0-inextendibility theorem, but it is a statement about one exact solution; it cannot carry the generic class by itself.

sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.exact_theorem: The maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime is manifestly inextendible as a Lorentzian manifold with a twice continuously differentiable metric. In this paper, we prove the stronger statement that it is even inextendible as a Lorentzian manifold with a continuous metric.
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.falsifier: A C^2 extension of the maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime (which would also refute the C^0 statement, since C^0-inextendibility implies C^2-inextendibility for the same manifold).
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild.notes: One-way implication: C^0-inextendibility implies C^2-inextendibility; the converse is false in general, so this row may not be used to infer the C^0 statement for other spacetimes.

sbierski_c0_schwarzschild_v2.exact_theorem: This article presents a streamlined version of the author's original proof of the $C^0$-inextendibility of the maximal analytic Schwarzschild spacetime.
assumptions: streamlined proof; same result as arXiv:1507.00601
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild_v2.falsifier: A gap in the streamlined proof not present in the original; check the Galloway-Ling-Sbierski geodesic-exit lemma it invokes.
sbierski_c0_schwarzschild_v2.notes: Companion/streamlined proof. Does not extend the class.
Result is stated at C^0 regularity only; C^2 row carried by the original paper.

klainerman_rodnianski_trapped.genericity_stated: open set of regular initial conditions
klainerman_rodnianski_trapped.exact_theorem: [Christodoulou] has identified an open set of regular initial conditions on an outgoing null hypersurface (both finite and at past null infinity) leading to a formation a trapped surface in the corresponding vacuum space-time to the future of the initial outgoing hypersurface and another incoming null hypersurface with the prescribed Minkowskian data. In this paper we give a simpler proof for a finite problem by enlarging the admissible set of initial conditions.
klainerman_rodnianski_trapped.theorem_locator: abstract (their simplification of Christodoulou's trapped-surface theorem)
assumptions: characteristic initial data on an outgoing null hypersurface
conclusion is trapped-surface formation, not completeness of future null infinity
klainerman_rodnianski_trapped.falsifier: A vacuum evolution from the same data class that forms no trapped surface while producing a singularity visible from infinity; or a counterexample to the propagation estimates used.
klainerman_rodnianski_trapped.notes: This is the nearest positive vacuum result to WCC in the matrix, and it still does not state WCC: trapped-surface formation is not I+ completeness.
Exterior/collapse result; no interior extension statement.

li_yu_cauchy_data.genericity_stated: constructed family (not stated as open dense)
li_yu_cauchy_data.exact_theorem: We show the existence of complete, asymptotically flat Cauchy initial data for the vacuum Einstein field equations, free of trapped surfaces, whose future development must admit a trapped surface.
assumptions: data exactly Minkowski inside and Kerr outside (glued)
conclusion is trapped-surface formation, not I+ completeness
li_yu_cauchy_data.falsifier: A re-examination showing the glued data are not complete/asymptotically flat as claimed, or that the trapped surface does not form in the maximal development.
li_yu_cauchy_data.notes: AGAINST reading it as WCC: collapsing to a black hole is necessary but not sufficient for weak cosmic censorship.

an_luk_trapped.genericity_stated: class of initial data large merely in a scaling-critical norm
an_luk_trapped.exact_theorem: First, we extend the region of existence in Christodoulou's theorem on the formation of trapped surfaces and consequently show that the lower bound required to form a trapped surface can be relaxed. Second, we demonstrate that trapped surfaces form dynamically from a class of initial data which are large merely in a scaling-critical norm.
assumptions: conclusion is trapped-surface formation, not I+ completeness
an_luk_trapped.falsifier: A corrected propagation estimate showing the relaxed bound fails, or data in the stated critical class that develop no trapped surface.
an_luk_trapped.notes: Same caveat as the other collapse rows: trapped-surface formation is a step towards WCC, not WCC.

rsr_naked_singularities.genericity_stated: self-similar construction; no genericity claimed (measure-zero / non-generic)
rsr_naked_singularities.exact_theorem: In a previous work [I. Rodnianski and Y. Shlapentokh-Rothman, Naked Singularities for the Einstein Vacuum Equations: The Exterior Solution, arXiv:1912.08478] we constructed solutions to the Einstein vacuum equations in 3+1 dimensions which corresponded to the exterior region of a naked singularity. In this work we construct solutions which correspond to the interior region and show that the two solutions may be glued together to produce a naked singularity.
rsr_naked_singularities.theorem_locator: abstract (companion exterior result: arXiv:1912.08478, not separately fetched in this run)
assumptions: companion exterior paper not independently fetched here
rsr_naked_singularities.falsifier: A defect in the gluing, or a demonstration that the constructed data are not asymptotically flat / not regular; either would remove the naked-singularity conclusion.
rsr_naked_singularities.notes: The genericity clause is doing essential work: this counterexample does not refute the generic WCC statement, it shows a non-generic naked singularity exists in vacuum. It also flags that the exterior companion (1912.08478) must be fetched before this row is promoted.

van_de_moortel_c2.genericity_stated: assuming (sufficiently slow) decay of the charged scalar field on the event horizon
van_de_moortel_c2.exact_theorem: As a result, we prove in spherical symmetry that: - two-ended asymptotically flat space-times are $C^2$-future-inextendible i.e. $C^2$ Strong Cosmic Censorship is true for Einstein-Maxwell-Klein-Gordon, assuming the decay of the scalar field on the event horizon at the expected rate.
van_de_moortel_c2.falsifier: An initial data set in this model where the decay hypothesis holds but a C^2 extension across the Cauchy horizon exists; or an error in the mass-inflation/rigidity dichotomy.
van_de_moortel_c2.notes: The strongest positive C^2-SCC theorem in the registry, but the class it covers is strictly broader than vacuum (matter present), so it cannot be promoted to AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN. Recorded as an analogue, not as coverage.
C^2 conclusion only; do not read it as a C^0 statement.
Charged Klein-Gordon, not the massless neutral scalar of the class.

hintz_vasy_kerr.exact_theorem: we obtain boundedness, regularity and decay of linear scalar waves on subextremal Reissner-Nordström and (slowly rotating) Kerr spacetimes, without any symmetry assumptions [...] We show polynomial decay of linear waves relative to a Sobolev space of order slightly above $1/2$. This complements the generic $H^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$ blow-up result of Luk and Oh.
assumptions: linear scalar waves on a fixed subextremal Kerr background
does not state a C^2-inextendibility theorem
hintz_vasy_kerr.falsifier: A nonlinear treatment showing the linear decay mechanism is destroyed by backreaction in the class; or a mode with slower decay on Kerr than the stated Sobolev-order bound.
hintz_vasy_kerr.notes: Linear input only. Useful for the C^2 column because C^2-inextendibility would fail if waves (and hence curvature) extended smoothly; decay alone does not prove it.
Linear boundedness/decay says nothing about C^0 inextendibility.

dafermos_price_law.genericity_stated: spherically symmetric initial data (not an open-dense statement)
dafermos_price_law.exact_theorem: In this paper, we prove a well-defined (upper bound) formulation of Price's law for the collapse of a self-gravitating scalar field with spherically symmetric initial data. We also allow the presence of an additional gravitationally coupled Maxwell field.
assumptions: does not prove completeness of future null infinity
dafermos_price_law.falsifier: A spherical collapse solution whose radiation flux decays strictly slower than the proven upper bound, or a gap in the conformal/red-shift energy argument.
dafermos_price_law.notes: The abstract also states that, combined with Dafermos gr-qc/0307013, the C^0 formulation of SCC is false for that matter system -- a matter-model falsifier, not a vacuum one.
Its C^0 falsification is for a matter model, never for vacuum.

dafermos_charged_interior.notes: Class-leakage trap: Einstein-Maxwell-scalar, spherical. Its C^0 falsification must never be quoted as vacuum.
Matter model; spectrum of the mass-inflation mechanism only.

Abstract states: the spacetime is extendible as a continuous metric but inextendible as a differentiable metric, so under Christodoulou's C^0 formulation SCC is false for this system. Recorded as a boundary case for the matter model; strictly out of the vacuum class.

dafermos_charged_interior.genericity_stated: Price-law decay assumed on the event horizon
dafermos_charged_interior.exact_theorem: the maximal domain of development has a future boundary, over which the spacetime is extendible as a continuous metric, but along which the Hawking mass blows up identically; thus, the spacetime is inextendible as a differentiable metric.
assumptions: Einstein-Maxwell-scalar, spherical symmetry, characteristic initial value problem
includes a Maxwell field, so broader than the massless-scalar class
dafermos_charged_interior.falsifier: A corrected interior analysis showing the Hawking mass stays bounded (no mass inflation) for the stated decay class.
dafermos_charged_interior.notes: Interior structure in a scalar+matter model; supports the mass-inflation picture used by WCC/SCC arguments but is not itself a WCC theorem.

warped_c0_birmingham_kottler.genericity_stated: whole one-horizon family with nonpositive cosmological constant and closed connected fiber satisfying a Ricci condition; no genericity over data
warped_c0_birmingham_kottler.exact_theorem: The local obstruction and the geodesic classification imply $C^0$-inextendibility for the one-horizon Birmingham-Kottler family with nonpositive cosmological constant and every closed connected fiber satisfying $\text{Ric}_{\gamma_\Sigma}=(n-2)k\gamma_\Sigma$, without assumptions of homogeneity, orientability, or simple connectivity.
assumptions: exact static Birmingham-Kottler family (includes Schwarzschild for Lambda=0)
not a statement about generic non-static vacuum data
warped_c0_birmingham_kottler.falsifier: A continuous extension of one of the covered static spacetimes, or a gap in the radial compression / terminal causal trace argument.
warped_c0_birmingham_kottler.notes: Static-family C^0 result, broadens the exact-solution evidence beyond Schwarzschild. Still cannot carry the generic class.
C^0 statement; C^2 implication is one-way and covered by the C^0 row's note.

warped_c0_class.genericity_stated: class of warped-product spacetimes under stated assumptions (compact, connected, homogeneous, orientable fiber); no genericity over initial data
warped_c0_class.exact_theorem: Under suitable assumptions, including that the fibre is closed (compact without boundary), connected, homogeneous, and orientable, we establish future $C^0$-inextendibility for spacetimes in this class. The result further extends to spacetimes possessing more than one regular black hole horizon.
assumptions: warped-product black hole spacetimes with static exterior
not a generic dynamical data statement
warped_c0_class.falsifier: A covered warped-product spacetime with a continuous extension, or a counterexample to the Kretschmann-divergence / closed-fiber hypotheses.
warped_c0_class.notes: Shows the C^0-inextendibility technique generalises beyond Schwarzschild, but the covered family is static and may be nonvacuum; class binding stays narrower.
